claims.claim: The committed repair modifies only the seven authorized files and preserves protected workflow, operator, attention, browser-acquisition, and roadmap surfaces.
TASK parsing supports strict origin and legacy selectors; new authoring requires explicit classification and rejects ordinary revision affinity transfers.
RUN and lease representations inherit immutable TASK affinity. Exact persisted carrier drift fails closed while existing structural and identity validators retain their diagnostic boundaries.
The read-only resolver reconstructs selectors from exact canonical or admitted lineage, follows recovery's original event, preserves event identities, and returns no affinity for unproved lineage.

Origin resolution matches the exact handle and generation through bounded machine-local state, retains raw routing values locally, and blocks invalid or uncertain state without default-route fallback.
Each handle owns one serialized durable lane. Distinct routes retain independent state and locks; duplicate proof now reads validated lane state only under its lock.
Possible clicks persist the attempted generation before submission; ambiguous reconciliation uses its stored binding and cannot redirect or authorize resend.
Historical fixtures explicitly exercise legacy classification, while origin-affine workflow fixtures provide exact selectors and local registry context without weakening production safeguards.
Direct and follow-up delivery remain scoped to the exact event's lane; scheduled rechecks enumerate bounded configured or admitted lanes and preserve independent progress and submission guards.

Focused regression definitions cover propagation, lineage reconstruction, isolation, legacy separation, fail-closed routing, generation ambiguity, and workflow scoping. Repair-local checks passed; H4C0 bootstrap implementation and coverage remain unchanged.
Documentation records selector, lineage, lane, privacy, and explicit-transfer contracts and retains publication, live conformance, H4D/H4E, and roadmap closure as downstream authority-owned facts.
This package binds the clean committed candidate, reports only the narrow repair delta and implementation properties, and leaves canonical verification and downstream verdicts to their owners.
